SiteConfig.title: SiteConfig
SiteConfig.description: Shared real-time website branding, title configuration, access lock settings, and connected Google Sheet pointer synchronized across AI Studio and GitHub Pages.

spreadsheetId.description: Connected Google Spreadsheet ID (empty string if not bound yet).

tabName.description: Active Google Sheet tab name containing journal posts.

siteTitle.description: Primary site title shown in navbar and browser tab.

siteSubtitle.description: Secondary subtitle shown in browser tab and hero eyebrow.

heroHeading.description: Main hero headline on the homepage.

autoDynamicTitle.description: Whether browser <title> automatically updates for active article or filters.

autoTitleFromSheet.description: Whether to sync site title from a Google Sheet Settings tab.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update.

updatedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the admin user who last updated the config.

hiddenOfficialAssetIds.description: Optional bounded list of official Ximen asset IDs deleted or hidden by teachers.

lockedCategories.description: Optional bounded list of journal categories restricted to @hmes.tp.edu.tw school members and admins.

lockedNavOptions.description: Optional bounded list of feature/navigation option IDs restricted to @hmes.tp.edu.tw school members and admins.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Authorized co-teacher or administrator allowed to update shared siteConfig and manage community meetings.

addedAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted.

addedByUid.description: UID of the admin who granted access.

XimenGalleryItem.title: XimenGalleryItem
XimenGalleryItem.description: Uploaded image asset in the Ximen Scratch Stage Show Gallery Center, writable only by teachers/admins and readable by teachers or verified @hmes.tp.edu.tw school members.

name.description: Display name of the gallery image.

fileName.description: Original filename of the uploaded image.

folderName.description: Folder or relative directory path containing the image (empty string if uncategorized).

imageUrl.description: Direct image preview URL (HTTPS or compressed Base64 Data URL).

downloadUrl.description: Direct download URL for the asset (HTTPS or compressed Base64 Data URL).

driveFileId.description: Google Drive file ID for asset cleanup and direct download.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the uploaded image file.

uploadedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the uploading teacher.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the asset was added.

MeetingSession.title: MeetingSession
MeetingSession.description: Meeting or School Day check-in session. Sessions with audience 'teacher' (or omitted) are strictly private to @hmes.tp.edu.tw school members and admins; sessions with audience 'parent' (e.g. School Day) are publicly visible so parents can sign in without logging in.

title.description: Meeting or School Day event title.

meetUrl.description: Optional HTTPS Google Meet or handout URL.

linkedPostSlug.description: Optional slug of a related journal article.

audience.description: Target audience: 'teacher' requires @hmes.tp.edu.tw sign-in; 'parent' allows login-free School Day parent check-in.

isOpen.description: Whether check-in is manually enabled by admins.

allowLeaveReport.description: Optional flag (defaults to true when omitted) enabling teacher leave status reporting (公假/事假/病假/其他請假) and leave notes.

checkinStartAt.description: Optional server-enforced start timestamp when attendees can begin signing.

checkinEndAt.description: Optional server-enforced cutoff timestamp after which signing closes.

createdByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the creating admin.

MeetingCheckin.title: MeetingCheckin
MeetingCheckin.description: Teacher attendance and leave check-in record keyed deterministically by {meetingId}_{userUid}. Contains teacher email PII so reads are strictly isolated to the record owner or admins.

userUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the checking-in teacher (or generated ID when recorded by an admin for an absent teacher).

userEmail.description: Verified institutional or admin email (may be empty string when an admin records leave on behalf of an absent teacher).

attendanceStatus.description: Attendance or leave status (defaults to '出席' when omitted on legacy documents).

leaveNote.description: Optional leave reason, official notice, substitute teacher, or attendance remark.

roleOrNote.description: Optional teaching grade or attendance remark.

signatureDataUrl.description: Base64-encoded PNG/WebP/JPEG data URL of the teacher's personal handwritten signature (required when attendanceStatus is '出席'; empty string allowed when on leave).

ParentCheckin.title: ParentCheckin
ParentCheckin.description: School Day login-free parent attendance check-in record with handwritten signature. Write-only create for parents targeting an open 'parent' session; reads, lists, updates, and deletes are strictly restricted to admins to protect student/parent PII.

meetingTitle.description: Snapshot of the School Day session title.

studentClassAndSeat.description: Student class/seat or student name entered by the parent.

relationshipOrNote.description: Optional parent relationship label (e.g. 爸爸/媽媽/監護人) or brief remark.

signatureDataUrl.description: Base64-encoded PNG/WebP/JPEG data URL of the parent's handwritten signature.

/siteConfig/{configId}.description: Publicly readable, admin-writable shared site configuration document ('main').

/admins/{userId}.description: Administrator allowlist documents keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/ximenGalleryItems/{itemId}.description: Role-gated gallery images readable/downloadable by @hmes.tp.edu.tw school members and teachers, writable/deletable only by teachers/admins.

/meetings/{meetingId}.description: Teacher community meeting sessions publicly readable so all teachers (logged in or not) can receive live check-in notices and scan QR codes; created/updated/deleted only by admins.

/parentMeetings/{meetingId}.description: Dedicated School Day / parent event sessions (audience='parent'), strictly isolated from teacher community meetings and publicly readable for login-free parent check-in; created/updated/deleted only by admins.

/meetingCheckins/{checkinId}.description: Deterministic ({meetingId}_{uid}) teacher attendance check-in records. School members may create/update/delete their own record while the meeting is open; reads/lists are isolated to the owner or admins to prevent PII scraping.

/parentCheckins/{checkinId}.description: Login-free School Day parent attendance check-in records. Parents can create records only for open parentMeetings within the allowed schedule window; all reads, lists, updates, and deletes are strictly restricted to admins.
